facts.text: I want to provide a bunch of data that could be used to extract interesting statistics for a business development manager or sales manager.
My goal is to sell more Terms and Conditions.
My data is about newly registered businesses in specific areas in Auckland.
I do not know the demographics of the areas in Auckland.
I can provide 6 months worth of new registrations in each sector of business.
I can provide the date of registrations.
I asked what the best format for the data is.
I asked whether csv would work ok because it is text based.
I provided the format of the data with columns including nzbn, entityName, changeDateTime, createdAt, classificationDescription, and postCodes.
